summary: Drop is a self-hosted platform tailored for distributing and sharing DRM-free titles. It functions as a private alternative to mainstream distribution networks like Steam or GameVault, allowing you to manage your game library independently.
goodFor: It suits individuals or small groups wishing to host, organise, and distribute their own collection of DRM-free games from a private server.
watchOut: As an early-stage project under the AGPL-3.0 licence, it carries typical maturity risks and overlaps heavily with more established distribution alternatives.
deployNotes: Since it is packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for game files and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
